text_simplified: This text speaks of the virtue of tarbiyah (upbringing) of daughters and ihsan (excellence) towards them. For whoever raises three daughters or sisters and treats them with ihsan until they reach maturity or pass away, they will be a shield for him from the Fire. It also clarifies that patience in the face of losing loved ones, coupled with ihtisab (seeking reward from Allah), carries a great reward. And that if a believer is afflicted with the loss of his dear ones from this world, then he endures with patience and ihtisab, his reward will be Paradise.

review_defects.arabic: إذا أخذ صفيه من أهل الدنيا
review_defects.english: if a believer is afflicted with the loss of his dear ones from this world
review_defects.why: Arabic 'صفيه' is singular ('his chosen one' or 'his close friend'), but English renders it as plural 'dear ones'. Also 'afflicted with the loss' is an interpretive addition not explicitly in the Arabic.
